title: Change details on a SafeWork NSW licence
summary: Update your SafeWork NSW licence or card if you have changed your name or contact details.
intro:
If you change your name or contact details, you need to update your SafeWork NSW licence or card.

Follow the steps on this page to update your:

For other SafeWork NSW licences
what_you_need: Your licence, certificate, or card number
A certified copy of either an Australian marriage certificate or an Australian change of name certificate (if changing your name)
A certified copy of any changes to your registered business or trading name certificate of registration (if changing your business or trading name)

how_to_steps.text: Follow the prompts to update your details.

more_info.text: To find your SafeWork NSW licence number and details, visit Verify NSW.
Once your new card arrives, you must return your old card within 7 days. You can post it to:Customer Service CentreSafeWork NSWLocked Bag 2906Lisarow NSW 2252.
